Recovery requires trusted evidence, director/tech operator policies and registration-only grant. 11 Identity plus nine core HTTP/PG scenarios; 31 DB and six QA tests, two maintenance CLI smokes; fresh and populated prior-schema upgrade verified. QA domain/hardware/browser and production GO remain unverified.
nodes.current_resolution: TASK-12 verifies password and Chromium passkey enrollment/authentication on the approved permanent onlineschool-xi.vercel.app origin. Physical authenticator and FND-GATE/production GO remain unverified.

nodes.label: TASK-08: Finance, exact ledger, paid entitlements and teacher payroll; PG18 verified
nodes.summary: 17 operations; 14 Finance HTTP/PG scenarios under least-privilege runtime role, 85 automated regression tests overall. Full confirmed allocations, separate director temporary access, SQL serialized consumption, canonical ledger/reversal, immutable actual-start rate evidence, six-month rehire, explicit individual promises and UNKNOWN payout isolation. Worker expiry creates one internal CRM task. Fresh and populated prior-schema upgrade preserved all existing values; external staging, bank integration, legal finalization and production GO remain unverified.

nodes.label: Phase 0 verification policy: large regressions deferred by owner 2026-10-26

nodes.label: TASK-09: Schedule and calendar
nodes.summary: 15 Schedule operations (13 requested plus explicit generation/start), stable local-day occurrence identity, row-locked availability/exclusion, observed calendar corrections with immutable actual teacher/rate, separate report/confirmation, 24h/star internal worker tasks. 13 focused HTTP/PG and two DST tests predate the final DTO integration; full regression is deferred. Five-migration PG18 fresh and data-preserving prior Task08 upgrade verified.
